description: This file defines a set of functions and data structures for managing push relay registration state using Keychain storage. It includes encoding/decoding of registration information and functions to load, save, and clear registration data, as well as handling app attestation key IDs.

classes.name: StoredPushRelayRegistrationState
classes.description: A Codable struct representing the stored state for push relay registration, including relay handle, grant, origin, device ID, expiry, token hash, installation ID, and last transport.

classes.name: PushRelayRegistrationStore
classes.description: A namespace struct providing static methods to load, save, and clear push relay registration state and related key IDs from the Keychain.

classes.name: RegistrationState
classes.description: A Codable struct representing the registration state used within the application, including relay handle, grant, origin, device ID, expiry, token suffix, token hash, installation ID, and last transport.

methods.name: loadRegistrationState
methods.description: Loads registration state data from Keychain, decodes it, and returns a RegistrationState object if successful.

methods.name: saveRegistrationState
methods.description: Encodes and saves the given RegistrationState to Keychain, returning true if successful.

methods.name: clearRegistrationState
methods.description: Deletes the registration state entry from Keychain.

methods.name: loadAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the App Attest Key ID from Keychain, trimming whitespace and returning nil if empty or not found.

methods.name: saveAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Saves the provided App Attest Key ID to Keychain.

methods.name: clearAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Removes the App Attest Key ID from Keychain.

methods.name: loadAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the Attested Key ID from Keychain, trimming whitespace and returning nil if empty or not found.

methods.name: saveAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Saves the provided Attested Key ID to Keychain.

methods.name: clearAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Removes the Attested Key ID from Keychain.
